newsitem.title: USA: Senators say ethanol tax break a good deal for US.
newsitem.headline: Senators say ethanol tax break a good deal for US.

text.p: Seven farm-state senators sent a letter to House Ways and Means chairman Bill Archer on Thursday, asking him to look at ethanol's benefits before any attempt to eliminate a tax break for the fuel.

"We hope that before your committee takes any action it will take a careful look at the whole picture, including the demonstrated benefits associated with the production and use of biomass-derived alcohol fuels," they wrote to Archer, Texas Republican.
Ethanol boosts farm income and overall U.S. employment while reducing reliance on oil imports, the letter said.

Signing the letter were Senate Democratic Leader Tom Daschle of South Dakota, Tom Harkin, Iowa Democrat, Byron Dorgan, North Dakota Democrat, Tim Johnson, South Dakota Democrat, Carol Moseley-Braun, Illinois Democrat, Dick Durbin, Illinois Democrat, and Kent Conrad, North Dakota Democrat.
